pages.text: Every 20 to 45 minutes, an event shakes the Nether for a few minutes:$(br)$(li)$(l)Ash fall$(): thick grey fog, Ash Wraiths and Withered Knights grow stronger.$(li)$(l)Sulfur storm$(): sulfur falls from the ceiling, pick it up!$(li)$(l)Eruption$(): in Magma Rifts and Basalt Deltas, volcanic bombs, magma and ores rain down.
pages.title: Événements

pages.text: The full $(item)Wraith armor$() lets you see through the ash fall.$(br2)Server operators can start or stop an event with $(l)/netheryx event start <type>$() and $(l)/netheryx event stop$(). Events can be disabled in the config.
